close_reason: TlsrptRecorder and TlsrptFailureType implemented; check+clippy clean
description: Implement a TlsrptRecorder that accumulates SMTP TLS failure records per recipient domain during a delivery session. On MTA-STS enforcement failure or REQUIRETLS failure, call record_failure(recipient_domain, policy_domain, failure_type: TlsrptFailureType, receiving_mx, total_session_count, failed_session_count). TlsrptFailureType variants per RFC 8460 §4.3: starttls-not-supported, certificate-host-mismatch, certificate-expired, certificate-not-trusted, validation-failure, tlsa-invalid, dnssec-invalid, dane-required, sts-policy-fetch-error, sts-policy-invalid, sts-webpki-invalid. Daily report generation (aggregate JSON per RFC 8460 §4) is a follow-on bead; this bead handles accumulation only.
title: TLSRPT failure record accumulator
